purpose: Release qualification receipt for the GLM-5.2 projection-mixed EXL3 serving profile

implemented_contracts.projection_mixed_experts: Checkpoint-native Trellis K3, K4, and K5 routed-expert projections retain independent bitrate maps and execute through the B12X W4A16 owner.
implemented_contracts.uniform_rank_slices: Uniform rank-sliced routed-expert payloads are prepared through the native BTX layout contract before B12X adopts their storage without copying.
implemented_contracts.route_pack_warmup: Route-pack warmup keys include token count, top-k width, caller-owned route slots, route blocks, block size, expert count, route dtype, expert mapping, and device.
implemented_contracts.online_dense_quantization: Eligible BF16 dense projections are encoded as persistent Trellis MCG K6 payloads and reused by checkpoint revision.
implemented_contracts.cuda_graphs: The qualified TP4 profile captured PIECEWISE and FULL prefill graphs and a FULL decode graph.

result: The GLM-5.2 projection-mixed EXL3 checkpoint loaded without source overlays, captured the configured CUDA graphs, produced coherent output, and sustained 33.42 target steps per second in the C1 gate without a runtime failure.
limitations: GLM-5.2 NVFP4 TP8 was not executed against this image.
DeepSeek-V4-Flash was not executed against this image.
The C1 gate used MAX_NUM_SEQS=1 and a CUDA graph cap of 4 to isolate the routed-expert runtime contract.
